updates.summary: Sterling Center brings together Ranch Social for food and gathering, health services, and community help in one easy-to-find destination. Choose a place below for its visit details.
highlights: Ranch Social is the shared food-and-gathering space; the other listings are separate destinations in the building.
Primrose School is a separate school building at 8159 Piney River Avenue.

updates.summary: Ranch Social is Sterling Center's shared gathering place, with coffee, drinks, food, outdoor seating, a fire pit, and a log playground.
highlights: Atlas Coffee, Salta Wine & Cocktail Bar, Living the Dream Brewing Company, and Agora Market are located here.
Food trucks and community events are listed through Sterling Ranch's event calendar.

updates.summary: UCHealth Sterling Ranch Medical Center is at 8155 Piney River Avenue, Suite 100. It lists primary care, urgent care, and physical therapy clinics.
highlights: The operator's location page is the best place to choose a clinic and check current visit details.
Urgent care is listed as open seven days a week; check UCHealth before making a special trip.

updates.summary: The Sterling Ranch Info Center is at 8155 Piney River Avenue, Suite 110. Stop in for community and home-search information.

The Info Center and CAB share the same published on-site address.

The CAB page has links for common resident services, including reporting an issue, design review, billing, and amenity rentals.
